zh.summary: 新增官方账号登录：现在可以用 DeepSeek 账号一键登录，不再只能填 API 密钥。
highlights: 首次启动出现“开始使用”，可以选择“登录”或“添加 API Key”。登录会在系统浏览器里打开官方授权页，点一次授权即可，不需要在本软件里输入密码。
侧边栏左下角变成账号菜单，里面有“设置”“意见反馈”和“登录”。登录后可以查看账号状态和用量。
登录凭据保存在软件文件夹内的数据目录里，随文件夹一起移动；整个文件夹请自己保管，不要分享给别人。
upgradeNotes: 从 0.8.10 升级会保留设置、会话、插件和默认工作区。
“设置”现在在左下角“更多”菜单里，位置比以前多一步。
已经填好 API Key 的用户不受影响，仍可继续使用。

en.summary: Adds official account sign-in: you can now sign in with your DeepSeek account instead of only entering an API key.
highlights: First start shows "Get started" with Sign in or Add API Key. Sign-in opens the official authorization page in your system browser; one click authorizes and no password is typed into this app.
The sidebar footer is now an account menu with Settings, Feedback and Sign in. After signing in it shows account status and usage.
Sign-in credentials are stored in the data folder inside the app folder and move with it; keep the whole folder private and do not share it.
upgradeNotes: Upgrading from 0.8.10 keeps settings, sessions, plugins, and the default workspace.
Settings is now inside the More menu at the bottom left, one step further than before.
Users who already entered an API key are not affected and can keep using it.
